known_gaps.detail: Two separate parties share one game ID; there is no historical combined leader or co-leadership.
Resolve formal interim/caretaker classification for Major 22 June-4 July 1995, Howard 2005, May 7 June-23 July 2019 and Sunak 2024. Do not invent an acting replacement.
Clegg career ends 8 May 2015; Farron begins 16 July 2015. Reviewed official sources do not name an interim office holder. Do not auto-assign Sal Brinton based on presidency.
Party presidency diverges from Assembly leadership in 2003. Dafydd Iwan presidency must be researched before deciding whether the game wants that office, Jones political leadership, or both.
Secondary sources point to Ieuan Wyn Jones acting during Wigley illnessDecember 1999-February 2000; no precise primary timeline accepted yet. Keep as research lead only.
Election-result reports vary 27/28 September 2018; actual primary statement or party filing needed. Current accepted earliest direct record is 2 October.
Separate interim nomination, ratification and effective handover; exact 16/17 May boundary not yet accepted.
Labour official 17 July 2026 election statement conflicts with GOV.UK 16 July biography. Starmer party-office endpoint/caretaker gap also unresolved.
Official profile photos are candidate likeness references only. No image rights, exact historical-year appearance, texture files or generated avatars are established by this research.
Leadership handover is established in September 2000; exact 23/26 September date still differs across official records. Normalized terms use common month precision.

integration_notes: Historical office terms provide candidate provenance; they do not order replacement of a gameplay-elected incumbent.
Conservative affiliation windows prove membership only during leadership. A leadership end is not proof of party exit and should not force incumbent removal.
Open office ends mean current verified incumbent through 7 September 2026; they do not predict later events.
SNP and Plaid Cymru hold separate component offices inside the aggregate uk_nat game row.
Half-open intervals use successor/effective departure as until. Month/year precision must not become invented first-day transitions.
